transtype.name: openapi2dita
transtype.desc: OpenAPI / Swagger to DITA map and topics

param.name: openapi.group-by
param.desc: How operations are grouped in the map: by their first tag, by first path segment, or not at all.

param.name: openapi.map-name
param.desc: File name (without extension) for the generated map. Defaults to the input file name.

param.name: openapi.lang
param.desc: Value for xml:lang on generated maps and topics. Defaults to en-US.

param.name: openapi.curl
param.desc: Add an example curl request to each operation topic.

param.name: openapi.schemas
param.desc: Generate a topic for each named schema (data model).

param.name: openapi.markdown
param.desc: Convert Markdown in descriptions to DITA markup using the bundled org.lwdita parser.
